answer: The ferrous test I would run is Blessed orchestra conductor licence with conductors guild attestation: a licence the guild renews after concert audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a licence the guild renews after concert audits stays private; the island is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the vine of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
